data.one_liner: Clears all active Android and iOS notifications with a single static method
data.what_it_does: This plugin exposes a static method that removes every notification currently displayed on Android and iOS devices. It works by calling platform-specific APIs to cancel all notifications.
use_when: You need to clear all notifications at once, e.g., after a user logs out or completes a task
You want a lightweight solution without additional dependencies
avoid_when: You need granular control over individual notifications
You are already using a full-featured notification plugin like flutter_local_notifications
weaknesses: No support for notification scheduling or custom actions
Limited to clearing all notifications, not selective removal

alternatives.name: flutter_local_notifications
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides comprehensive notification management, including scheduling, custom actions, and platform-specific features
